## 5. BORROWER OBLIGATIONS

### 5.1 Use of Funds
The Borrower agrees to use the loan proceeds solely for the stated purpose: [LOAN_PURPOSE]

### 5.2 Timely Payment
The Borrower agrees to make all payments on or before the due date.

### 5.3 Notification
The Borrower must notify the Platform immediately of:
- Change of contact information
- Change of employment
- Financial difficulties
- Inability to make payments

### 5.4 Accuracy of Information
The Borrower warrants that all information provided is true, accurate, and complete.

---

## 6. LENDER RIGHTS

### 6.1 Interest Payments
Lenders are entitled to receive their proportionate share of:
- Monthly interest payments
- Principal repayments
- Late fees (if applicable)

### 6.2 Information Access
Lenders have the right to:
- View loan performance
- Receive payment notifications
- Access borrower profile (anonymized)

### 6.3 Secondary Market
Lenders may sell their loan portions on the secondary market (subject to Platform terms).

---

## 7. DEFAULT AND REMEDIES

### 7.1 Events of Default
Default occurs when:
- Payment is 30 days overdue
- Borrower provides false information
- Borrower files for bankruptcy
- Borrower violates loan terms

### 7.2 Consequences of Default
Upon default:
- Entire loan balance becomes immediately due
- Late fees accumulate
- ZimScore is negatively affected
- Collection proceedings begin
- Legal action may be initiated
- Default reported to credit bureaus

### 7.3 Collection Process
**Days 1-5:** Grace period, no action  
**Days 6-15:** Reminder notifications sent  
**Days 16-30:** Late fee applied, phone contact  
**Days 31-60:** Formal default notice, collection agency engaged  
**Days 61+:** Legal proceedings initiated

### 7.4 Recovery Costs
Borrower is responsible for all collection costs, including:
- Collection agency fees
- Legal fees
- Court costs
- Administrative expenses

---

## 8. PLATFORM ROLE

### 8.1 Facilitation Services
The Platform provides:
- Loan origination and servicing
- Payment processing
- Borrower verification
- Lender-borrower matching
- Customer support

### 8.2 Not a Party
The Platform is not a party to the loan agreement and:
- Does not guarantee loan repayment
- Is not liable for borrower default
- Acts solely as a facilitator

### 8.3 Platform Fees
**Lender Fee:** 1% of interest earned  
**Borrower Fee:** [ORIGINATION_FEE]% origination fee

## 9. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES

### 9.1 Borrower Representations
The Borrower represents and warrants that:
- All information provided is accurate
- They have legal capacity to borrow
- No other party has claim to the funds
- They are not in bankruptcy proceedings
- They will use funds for stated purpose

### 9.2 Lender Representations
Each Lender represents and warrants that:
- They understand the risks of P2P lending
- They can afford to lose their investment
- They have read and understood this agreement
- They are not relying solely on Platform advice

## 10. INSURANCE AND PROTECTION

### 10.1 Optional Loan Protection
Borrowers may purchase optional loan protection insurance covering:
- Death
- Permanent disability
- Critical illness
- Job loss (subject to terms)

**Premium:** [INSURANCE_RATE]% of loan amount per month

### 10.2 Platform Protection Fund
A portion of platform fees contributes to a protection fund that may provide partial coverage for defaults (not guaranteed).

## 11. PRIVACY AND DATA PROTECTION

### 11.1 Information Sharing
Borrower consents to sharing of:
- Loan performance data with Lenders
- Credit information with credit bureaus
- Required information with regulators

### 11.2 Confidentiality
Personal information will be protected according to the Platform's Privacy Policy.

## 12. DISPUTE RESOLUTION

### 12.1 Negotiation
Parties agree to first attempt resolution through good-faith negotiation.

### 12.2 Mediation
If negotiation fails, parties will attempt mediation through a mutually agreed mediator.

### 12.3 Arbitration
Unresolved disputes will be settled through binding arbitration in Harare, Zimbabwe.

### 12.4 Governing Law
This agreement is governed by the laws of Zimbabwe.

---

## 13. MODIFICATIONS

### 13.1 Loan Modifications
Loan terms may be modified only by written agreement of all parties.

### 13.2 Hardship Provisions
In case of genuine financial hardship, Borrower may request:
- Payment plan restructuring
- Temporary payment reduction
- Loan term extension

Approval requires Platform and Lender consent.

---

## 14. EARLY REPAYMENT

### 14.1 Right to Prepay
Borrower may repay the loan in full at any time without penalty.

### 14.2 Prepayment Process
To prepay:
1. Notify Platform 7 days in advance
2. Request payoff amount
3. Make full payment
4. Receive confirmation

### 14.3 Interest Calculation
Interest is calculated only on outstanding balance. Early repayment saves future interest.

---

## 15. NOTICES

### 15.1 Method of Notice
All notices must be sent via:
- Email to registered address
- SMS to registered phone
- Platform messaging system
- Registered mail (for legal notices)

### 15.2 Deemed Receipt
Notices are deemed received:
- Email: 24 hours after sending
- SMS: Immediately
- Platform message: When read
- Mail: 5 days after posting

## 16. GENERAL PROVISIONS

### 16.1 Entire Agreement
This agreement constitutes the entire agreement between parties.

### 16.2 Severability
If any provision is invalid, remaining provisions remain in effect.

### 16.3 Waiver
Failure to enforce any provision does not constitute waiver.

### 16.4 Assignment
Borrower may not assign this agreement. Lenders may assign through secondary market.

### 16.5 Survival
Obligations survive loan repayment or default as necessary.
